nodes.intent: Resolve every repository objective through exactly one CyberAlchemy-v2 route and fail closed when no unique route or executable capability is available, while mandatory ontology enforcement remains separately suspended pending a governed Rust binding.

required_conditions: entry route is always CA2-ROUTE-ENTRY
exactly one objective route is selected
every authority root belongs to cyberAlchemy-v2
every fallback route is null
blocked capabilities remain blocked
native operations cannot expand route authority
resolve user-cited names through the project index before asking for paths
lookup returns resolved, ambiguous, not_found, or not_evaluable; it never selects the first ambiguous match
lookup source currency checks only selected entries; unrelated source drift cannot block a lookup
source discovery never grants implementation, project registration, or external-effect authority
explicit domainspec-core lookup selects CA2-ROUTE-DOMAINSPEC-CORE and the separate bounded inventory
physical source mounts select exactly the umbrella compatibility layout or the standalone Craft layout without search or missing-file fallback
logical cyberAlchemy-v2 sources remain inside the local checkout; external compiler sources retain their declared mount and source digests
ARE CLI evaluates the verified registry and returns non-authorizing decisions with caller session/request bindings
context, effect and continuation require a current route receipt; neither receipts nor caller metadata authenticate approvals
host hooks and MCP remain deferred stages; the local CLI neither dispatches effects nor creates durable repository sessions
prompt hook projection remains advisory, excludes raw prompt text from developer context, and does not prove native host delivery or grant effects
tool events require their originating in-memory request binding; Stop observations never certify completion; native terminal status is transport evidence only
body.missing_route_behavior: select CA2-ROUTE-AMBIGUOUS and request a decision

nodes.intent: Return scoped recent commit metadata only under an exact current source binding; rebuild stale cache data and never treat history as a session or authority.

required_conditions: explicit unambiguous project or literal path scope
first-parent history bounded to at most 100 commits and 1000 displayed file changes
HEAD, branch, worktree, shallow boundary, schema, scope and limits match the snapshot
query cannot write tracked files, Git index, refs, hooks or cache
explicit refresh writes only derived Git-private per-worktree cache
uncommitted work is separately observed; submodules are gitlinks only
no durable session lifecycle or operational authority inferred

nodes.intent: A repository agent can find recent committed changes for an explicitly selected project or path, with current provenance and separately labeled working-tree status.
Preserve one stable CyberAlchemy-v2 route identity with its objective, authority root, minimal read set, execution posture, authorization requirement, write ceiling, blockers, and forbidden fallback.
